key_insight: EMGKT improves radiology report generation by transferring medical knowledge at multiple granularities, from global context to fine-grained disease cues, while keeping inference lightweight.
clinical_relevance: The approach may help radiologists obtain more accurate, clinically styled X-ray reports by better identifying and describing key findings.
method: Uses a medical vision-language model to encode global contextual knowledge.
Adds fine-grained knowledge distillation with teacher and student embeddings; only the student is used at inference.
Incorporates a mixture of disease diagnosis expert classifiers initialized from disease embeddings to capture different levels of detail.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive experiments on two public datasets with multiple baselines, showing improved effectiveness and transferability.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the underlying knowledge embeddings and classifier initialization, so real-world gains may vary across datasets and imaging settings.
paper_title: Efficient Multi-Granularity Knowledge Transfer for Radiology Report Generation
